messages:
Priya: noticed clutter on the performance dashboard - legend overlaps axis labels on narrow widths. screenshot: https://redwood.example/snap/legend-clutter2.png
Omar: is this on mobile or desktop?
Priya: desktop narrow + docked panels. multiple units (ms, req/s, %) are making legend lines long.
Lena: quick thought: compact legend + unit pills, and move legend to a small floating pin the user can drag. helps keep canvas clear.
Omar: agree. also add a denoise toggle in the legend to suppress transient spikes (light smoothing + marker fade). backend can flag denoiseable series.
Priya: microcopy for denoise tooltip: "Temporarily reduce spike emphasis to compare baseline trends." Under 100 chars.
Lena: accessibility: floating element must be keyboard reachable and have aria-grabbed/aria-dropeffect semantics. add aria-live announcements when legend position changes.
Omar: visual: if collapsed show "Top 3 + 5 more" with expand control. when smoothing changes the ranking, show a small note: "Ranking uses current smoothing".
Priya: small UX nit: outlier badges are very bright. propose softer opacity and smaller size.
Lena: action items: Omar -> prototype floating pin + denoise toggle, Priya -> write microcopy + mock compact legend, Lena -> accessibility checklist. Sync Monday 9am.
UI-bot: Prototype uploaded: https://redwood.example/design/legend-pin-proto.png
